Giraffes are [[neutral]] [[beast]]s that are common in the [[Barrens]] in central [[Kalimdor]].

There are two types of giraffe. Barrens Giraffe, and Wandering Barrens Giraffe. The Barrens Giraffes are generally lower in level (11-16) than the wandering variety (16-19). Wandering Giraffes are mostly found close to [[Camp Taurajo]]. The lower variety are found a bit farther North. 


== Traits ==
* Giraffe corpses are [[skinnable]].
